spec.notes: Velocity is read as speed. The ball rolls almost straight toward the camera, so the motion is mostly in depth.
The displacement is dominated by the depth change of 0.481 m; the lateral shift is small.
Width is taken as the left-right extent of the table top. The front edge lies at about 0.84 m depth (where the ball reaches the edge) and the back edge at about 1.53 m; both give about 0.60 m.

Length is taken as the front-to-back (depth) extent of the table top. It is strongly foreshortened, so it is estimated from the depth difference between the back edge (about 1.53 m) and the front edge (about 0.84 m).
